title: Creative Commons - Minecraft Parkour Gameplay
description:
This 3 short video cuts of me doing this parkour map from this video:
https://youtu.be/n_Dv4JMiwK8

This video is uploaded under a creative commons license, please use it for whatever you would like

Recorded in 1080p, and uploaded in 4K to preserve quality.

The map creator does it much more consistently with less faults in the linked video, but I thought I'd try setting up shaders and giving Minecraft parkour a try since it is getting so popular for background footage. If there is enough demand I will upload longer and fault-less runs on a variety of maps. I am also considering creating my own maps.
